reviews.title: Terrible Account Recovery and Customer Support
reviews.text:
I got a new phone and tried to log in to my LINE account and transfer my existing account, but the experience has been absolutely terrible.

I have my phone number, email address, and Apple ID, yet LINE refuses to let me recover my account using any of them. The only option it gives me is to send a verification code to my old phone, which is dead. That’s exactly why I need to transfer my account to my new phone in the first place!

What is the point of having multiple ways to identify and verify your account if none of them can actually help you recover it? The verification system is completely unreasonable, and the customer support is extremely disappointing.

I have been setting up all my other apps on my new phone without any problems. LINE is the only app giving me this nightmare. I have also seen many other longtime users reporting the same issue and losing years of contacts and connections, with seemingly no meaningful solution from LINE.

An app should not make it this difficult for legitimate users to regain access to their own accounts. People invest years in building their contact lists and relationships on this platform, and losing all of that because of a rigid account recovery system is unacceptable.

reviews.title: Horrible Experience
reviews.text:
This temporary suspension is completely unreasonable and frustrating. I was using my LINE account normally when, all of a sudden, I was unable to send messages because my account was temporarily suspended for allegedly violating the Community Guidelines. However, I did absolutely nothing that violated any policy.

I have no idea what triggered this suspension, and the lack of a clear explanation makes the situation even more frustrating. What is even worse is that it is extremely difficult to contact LINE Support and get a proper response or resolution.

This is just a normal personal account, and I have never engaged in any activity that violates LINE’s policies. If this suspension was caused by an automated system, then the system clearly needs to be improved because innocent users should not be punished without a valid reason or a proper way to appeal.

Please review my account properly and remove this unjustified suspension. This is extremely inconvenient and unacceptable.

reviews.title: Terrible account recovery and customer service
reviews.text: I recently purchased a new phone which included a trade-in of my old device. After transferring all of my data to my new phone, I wiped my old phone and submitted it to the Apple Store, not thinking too much about logging back in to my Line account since I hadn’t changed phone numbers or any other sensitive information. I had switched phones back in 2021 and had no issues transferring everything over. Upon returning home, I discovered that I needed the old device to verify my account, and without it I would have no way of accessing my contacts or chat history on Line— I was completely locked out and would have to make a brand new account. I reached out to customer support, and they did nothing to help me recover my account but repeatedly send me to help articles that did not fit my situation. I’ve lost contact information for friends and family abroad that I may never be able to get back, all because of an inflexible security policy and completely useless customer service platform. I would not recommend this platform if you can avoid it.
